canonical_runtime_protocol.name: memory_admission_runtime_v1
canonical_runtime_protocol.test_result: 14/14 expected semantic outcomes; 14/14 Draft 2020-12 structurally valid
canonical_runtime_protocol.core_rule: Only receiver_decision=adopt memory with current context/policy and matching validated packet digest may be injected. Reject/hold must remain non-injected; all-rejected/all-held may remain empty or use an independently valid memory-free baseline; force_nonempty without any adopted record fails closed.

findings.summary: Outcome triangulation now independently supports memory abstention as a generic runtime safety invariant: RSCB-MC direct coding-domain ablation raises false-positive injection 0.0%->17.5% and worsens cumulative reward -31.740->-87.800 when abstention/non-injection is removed; MedExpMem retains 1.3%-5.8% harmful correct-to-incorrect effects despite anatomical scoping, similarity thresholding and LLM relevance filtering.

CogEEGAgent gives direct autonomous-science evidence for fail-closed evidence authority: 60/60 required-abstention repeats produce 0 releases, 200/200 inconsistent contract mutations are blocked, runtime lifecycle matrix is 20/20 and public hard-failure verifier 188/188. But 40/40 internally consistent wrong-template substitutions pass preflight, proving deterministic admissibility is not semantic truth. Release is derived from committed, typed, replayed, evidence-bound transitions; held-out confirmation reduces best-p false positives 16.5%->4.9% (reported 11.6-point reduction, 95% CI 11.0-12.1).

WorldEvolver supplies science-environment post-prediction abstention evidence. Selective Foresight exposes a memory-conditioned prediction only above confidence threshold and otherwise gives the frozen agent an empty signal. Noisy foresight is worse than no foresight in the fixed-agent diagnostic (ScienceWorld 0.251 vs 0.271 action accuracy); w/F improves or ties w/o-F in all eight planning cells, including ScienceWorld pairs 46.67->52.22, 62.22->63.33, 48.89->50.00 and 62.22->63.33. This is not an always-expose matched contrast and not an autonomous research workflow.

GSEM's first public pre-submission commit already contains both forced-fill and no-fill multi-start retrieval and wires no-fill as Ablation 4, proving abstention preservation is a separable design factor. No numerical no-fill outcome or exact evaluated-revision binding was found.

phase1_assessment.residual_dependency: All outcome-bearing scientist/medical/control systems inspected here still rely on model, scientific executor, environment, data or replay execution. They strengthen evidence-handoff semantics but do not establish an end-to-end zero-external-executor scheduled-Chat parity path.
